text:
Sara (CS): Morning async — quick standup for Quillwave renewal + webhook flakiness.
- What I did: coordinated legal + acct, confirmed renewal timeline (EOM 4/1), paused extra trial seats.
- Blockers: Quillwave is seeing repeated webhook 502s -> duplicated events -> billing spike. Support ticket #CS-811 open. Need an eng-side short-circuit for retries.
- Today: request a canary patch to add a per-customer no-retry header and a config toggle.

James (Eng): Copy. Can you drop a couple sample event IDs + last_delivery timestamps? I'm going to check the webhook-deliverer logs and start a small patch. I opened WIP PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 to add per-customer retry policy.

Leo (Support): Event IDs: EID-93a4, EID-93a5. last_delivery_ts: 2026-03-16T22:54:08Z and 2026-03-16T22:55:12Z. I've flagged billing and added notes to CS-811. Customer is on Dedicated but still using hosted callbacks.

Maria (SRE): Tracing shows 502s originate from quillwave-ingest v2 in eu-west-1. We see their endpoint closing connections with header timeouts. Suggested mitigation: add an 'X-Redwood-No-Retry: true' header for Quillwave, plus exponential backoff for transient 5xx. I can push a router config change if Eng ok.

James (Eng): Ok to add the header short-term. I'll canary deploy a change to webhook-deliverer to respect per-customer retry toggles. Patch queued in PR above, testing locally now.

Leo (Support): Thx. Also opened BILL ticket #BILL-902 for proactive credit if billing spike happens during mitigation.

Anita (PM): Customer asked for assurance that the renewal won't be impacted by unexpected usage. Can we confirm an ETA for the canary + full rollout? If we can get canary by EOD I'll prepare an update for the account.

James (Eng): Canary started. deploy-bot: [deploy] webhook-deliverer canary started by @james — build #387 — logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/387. Rolling to 20% regionally in eu-west-1. ETA ~45m. :thumbsup:

Maria (SRE): Monitoring shows canary in eu-west-1 with the header applied — deliveries suppressed retries for the sample events. I'll mute noisy duplicate alerts for Quillwave while we watch.

James (Eng): Canary looks stable after 18m, no retry storms observed for EID-93a4/EID-93a5. Rolling to 100% in eu-west-1 now, then expand to other regions. Will post when complete.

Sara (CS): Awesome — please ping when at 100% and I'll update Quillwave support contact and acct team. I'll also add a short note to the renewal doc that we applied a temporary retry override.

James (Eng): Quick test command if you need to repro locally:
```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.ai/deliver \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'X-Customer-ID: quillwave' \n  -H 'X-Redwood-No-Retry: true' \n  -d '{"event_id":"EID-93a4","payload":{"foo":"bar"}}'
```

Maria (SRE): Note: we'll want a follow-up to add this config to the console UI as a toggle (no-retry per customer) rather than a code change each time. I'll file a tracking ticket.

James (Eng): TODOs: 1) UI toggle ticket (#ISSUE-214), 2) postmortem template if this recurs, 3) merge PR and ship config to other regions. I'll create the issues after the rollout.

Leo (Support): I'll draft a short customer-facing note about the mitigation and the temporary billing credit path.

Anita (PM): Thanks — if canary completes today I will send the renewal update.

Sara (CS): Final summary: What I did — triaged, looped legal+acct+support+eng. Blockers — waiting for full rollout and legal signoff on renew wording. Today — confirm rollout completes and send renewal message. Thanks everyone. :heart:
